text: What review frequency does DORA require for a bank's ICT risk management framework, and which events should trigger an ad hoc review outside the regular review cycle?
How often do we have to review how our bank handles IT risks under DORA, and what kinds of events mean we need an extra review in between the regular ones?

Estoy preparando el calendario de revisiones del marco de riesgo TIC del banco: ¿cada cuánto pide DORA que se revise y qué tiene que pasar para que toque hacer una revisión extra fuera de ese calendario?

We operate a small payment business under our Member State's exemption for small payment institutions rather than holding full authorisation as a payment institution, and I have assumed that the exemption also places us outside the scope of DORA. Does DORA apply to our business at all?

I run a small payments company that works under my country's exemption for small payment firms instead of having a full licence. I assumed being exempt also means DORA doesn't apply to us. Is my business covered by DORA at all?

Tengo una empresa de pagos pequeña que funciona acogida a la exención para pequeñas entidades de pago de nuestro país, sin licencia completa. Yo daba por hecho que al estar exentos DORA no va con nosotros, ¿es así o nos aplica igualmente?

How frequently is a crypto-asset service provider that holds clients' crypto-assets in custody required to provide each client with a statement of the crypto-assets it holds for that client, and are clients entitled to request such a statement between the periodic ones?

We run a crypto exchange that keeps our customers' tokens for them. How often do we have to send each customer a statement of the crypto we're holding for them, and can customers also ask us for one in between?

Trabajo en un exchange de criptomonedas que custodia los tokens de sus clientes. ¿Cada cuánto tenemos que enviar a cada cliente un extracto de los criptoactivos que le guardamos, y puede el cliente pedirnos uno entre medias?

Can a Singapore-based crypto exchange with no MiCA authorisation continue serving clients in Germany who were onboarded on a reverse solicitation basis, without having to obtain an EU authorisation, and may it email those clients about the new tokens and services it is about to launch?

Our crypto exchange is based in Singapore and has no EU license. Some people in Germany found us by themselves and signed up. Can we keep serving them without getting licensed in the EU, and can we email them about the new tokens and services we're about to launch?

Nuestro exchange de cripto está en Singapur y no tiene licencia MiCA, pero se nos han registrado clientes en Alemania que nos encontraron por su cuenta. ¿Podemos seguir dándoles servicio sin tener que pedir licencia en la UE? ¿Y podemos mandarles correos anunciando los tokens y servicios nuevos que vamos a lanzar?

As a crypto-asset service provider authorised under MiCA, what information on the originator and on the beneficiary must accompany each transfer of crypto-assets we send to another crypto-asset service provider?
Our crypto exchange is licensed under MiCA. When we send crypto to another exchange, what details about the sender and the receiver have to go along with every transfer?
Somos un exchange con licencia MiCA: ¿qué datos de quien envía y de quien recibe tenemos que mandar con cada transferencia de cripto que hacemos a otro exchange?

Under MiCA, what must the business continuity policy of a mid-sized crypto-asset service provider operating an exchange contain, both as regards the objectives it must achieve and the ICT business continuity and recovery plans it must include?

We run a medium-sized crypto exchange licensed under the EU crypto rules and we're writing our plan for keeping the business going if something breaks. What does that plan have to include, both what it's supposed to achieve and which plans it needs for keeping our IT systems running and getting them back up after an outage?

Tenemos un exchange cripto mediano con licencia MiCA y estamos redactando la política de continuidad de negocio: ¿qué tiene que incluir según la normativa cripto, tanto en cuanto a los objetivos que debe cumplir como a los planes de continuidad y recuperación TIC que hay que tener?
Within what timeframe must a payment service provider respond to a consumer complaint about a duplicate card transaction, and in which circumstances may that timeframe be extended?
My card was charged twice for the same purchase and I complained to my bank. How long do they have to answer me, and when are they allowed to take longer?
Me han cobrado dos veces el mismo pago con tarjeta y he puesto una reclamación al banco, ¿cuánto tiempo tienen para contestarme y en qué casos pueden tardar más?

A consumer has only just noticed that her gym collected a direct debit approximately six weeks ago for a substantially higher amount than the usual monthly charge. She signed the direct debit mandate, but it did not state a fixed amount. Is she still entitled to a refund from her payment service provider notwithstanding the signed mandate?

I only just noticed my gym took a lot more than my usual monthly fee by direct debit about six weeks ago. I signed the direct debit form, but it didn't say a fixed amount. Can I still get my money back from my bank even though I signed it?

Me acabo de dar cuenta de que hace unas seis semanas el gimnasio me pasó un recibo domiciliado mucho más alto que la cuota de siempre. Firmé la domiciliación, pero en la hoja no ponía ninguna cantidad fija. ¿Todavía puedo pedirle al banco que me devuelva el dinero aunque firmé la domiciliación?

We are renegotiating the contract with the ICT third-party service provider that operates our core banking platform. In which circumstances must the bank be able to terminate the contractual arrangement?
We're renegotiating our deal with the company that runs our bank's core banking system. In what situations does the bank have to be able to end the contract with them?
En el banco estamos renegociando el contrato con el proveedor que nos lleva el core bancario. ¿En qué casos tenemos que poder rescindirlo?
What is the maximum administrative fine a national competent authority may impose on a mid-sized insurance undertaking for non-compliance with DORA?
What's the biggest fine our national regulator could give our mid-sized insurance company for not following DORA?
Somos una aseguradora mediana: si el supervisor nacional nos multa por no cumplir con DORA, ¿cuál es la multa máxima que nos podría caer?
